descriptions.d16b_reset_entry_items_800a7488: Reset every item of one entry by type. Types 0 and 5 clear a set latch and, when the item is idle, send its cached message and the entry name text. Type 2 clears a set flag and announces when unlatched. Type 1 with a nonzero level: in mode 0 send the level 0.0 by float message plus the entry name; in modes 1 and 2 clear an armed flag (resetting the level) and announce when unlatched; then reset the level to 0.0. Other types are ignored. Partial observed layouts; 0.0 constant and cached keys referenced by address; no owned initialized data. Compiled with the original paired-single float switch -mps-float (reserves the FPR pair frame slots).
